note: The player-facing HUD and display options with their defaults, as data, for the settings menu and for Rendering (its FlashView reads info_flashes). UiHud loads these defaults over its own. Keys match UiHud.opts. Accessibility options are marked; none of them removes an information channel.

info_flashes.label: Info flashes
info_flashes.help: Small flashes over a fighter's head that show what he senses: danger, spotted you, searching. Turning this off hides only these.

silhouette.label: Body figure
silhouette.help: A small body figure beside each nameplate that shows wear, always on. On in training and by the accessibility default.

crown_always.label: Always show damage rings
crown_always.help: The rings that show each fighter's damage stay up all the time instead of fading. Flashes over the head still show; the rings dim under one.

brink_cue.label: Brink ring
brink_cue.help: A thin faint ring around a fighter on the brink.

edge_captions.label: Cue captions
edge_captions.help: A short line at the bottom edge names a cue as it happens, such as a beam struggle or an opening. Nothing is drawn on the fighters.

captions.label: Captions
captions.help: Bracketed sound tags such as [wince] on spoken lines.

latch_charge.label: Latched charge
latch_charge.help: A tap on Medium or Heavy starts its wind-up and the next press lets it go, for when holding a button is hard. Off: hold to charge.

latch_charge_p2.label: Latched charge, player 2
latch_charge_p2.help: The same for player two when two people play. Player one's is the one above.

charges_off.label: Charges off
charges_off.help: Every press is a tap: Medium and Heavy throw as soon as their wind-up ends, and holding does not charge. Off: hold to charge.

charges_off_p2.label: Charges off, player 2
charges_off_p2.help: The same for player two when two people play. Player one's is the one above.

reduce_flashing.label: Reduce flashing
reduce_flashing.help: Fewer and gentler flashes. Turning it off restores full effects, which flash more. Reduced motion is a separate setting.

reduced_motion.label: Reduced motion
reduced_motion.help: Removes flicker, shimmer and shrinking rings. The split screen swaps sides with a quick fade instead of a swing, and screen shake is cut to a quarter. Everything keeps its shape.

split_solo.label: Split screen against the computer
split_solo.help: Use the split screen when you play alone against the computer. Off keeps one camera on your fighter and shows the rival by an edge pointer and the ring map when it is far.

show_prompts.label: Show prompts
show_prompts.help: Button prompts on the parry ring, the finisher rings and under your nameplate. Always on in training and in the first three matches.

glyph_style.label: Glyph style
glyph_style.help: The look of the button glyphs. Neutral is our own position diamond with letters. A device family's own letters wait for a license check.

hitstop_scale.label: Hit pause
hitstop_scale.help: How long the game pauses for a moment on a heavy hit, from half to full.

hotseat_alt_layout.label: Alternate hot-seat keyboard layout
hotseat_alt_layout.help: A second keyboard layout for two players on one keyboard. Off keeps the default layout.

vfx_quality.label: Effects quality
vfx_quality.help: How much debris, dust and cracking the effects draw. Auto picks by how fast the game is running; the others fix it. Fewer effects never hide a warning.

haptics.label: Vibration
haptics.help: A short buzz on your pad or phone when you can transform. It is never the only signal: the screen says the same.

keep_hints.label: Keep tutorial hints up
keep_hints.help: In the guided first match, a hint stays on screen after you have done what it asks, until the next hint replaces it.

control_hints.label: Control hints
control_hints.help: A small legend of your controls in your corner. Auto shows it at the start of every match and in your first matches, always keeps it up, off hides it.

camera_zoom.label: Camera zoom
camera_zoom.help: How close the camera frames the fight, from 0 (far) to 10 (close). Fighters keep a minimum size on screen either way.

camera_shake.label: Camera shake
camera_shake.help: How hard the camera shakes on hits and blasts, from 0 (none) to 10 (most). Reduced motion caps it at a quarter.

camera_launch_follow.label: Launch camera
camera_launch_follow.help: Where the camera goes when a fighter is launched. Auto: it follows you if you are launched, keeps the computer in view if you launch it, and splits when two people play. Chase always follows the launched fighter. Split always shows both. Hold: when you launch someone the camera stays on you, then cuts to the impact.

camera_panels.label: Panel cut-ins
camera_panels.help: A slanted strip of the action in close-up for the big hits and finishing moments. Full: it opens and shuts with a wipe. Still: it shows a frozen frame and does not move. Off: none.

pad_preset.label: Controller layout
pad_preset.help: Arena: triggers dodge and charge power, bumpers guard and switch mode. Simple: fewer buttons, the game picks heavy, mode and specials for you.

pad_preset_p2.label: Controller layout, player 2
pad_preset_p2.help: The layout player two's controller uses when two people play. Player one's is the Controller layout above.

energy_style.label: Energy: hold or toggle
energy_style.help: Hold: energy attacks while you hold the energy control, physical when you let go. Toggle: press once to switch, press again to switch back. Toggle is for players who cannot hold a button while pressing another.

energy_style_p2.label: Energy: hold or toggle, player 2
energy_style_p2.help: The same for player two when two people play. Player one's is the one above.

guard_style.label: Guard: hold or toggle
guard_style.help: Hold: guard while you hold the guard control. Toggle: press once to start guarding, press again to stop. Toggle is for players who cannot hold a button down.

guard_style_p2.label: Guard: hold or toggle, player 2
guard_style_p2.help: The same for player two when two people play. Player one's is the one above.

manoeuvre_style.label: Manoeuvre stance: hold or toggle
manoeuvre_style.help: Hold: the manoeuvre stance, with its sprint, while you hold the dodge control. Toggle: press once to start, press again to stop. Toggle is for players who cannot hold a button down.

manoeuvre_style_p2.label: Manoeuvre stance: hold or toggle, player 2
manoeuvre_style_p2.help: The same for player two when two people play. Player one's is the one above.

charge_style.label: Charging stance: hold or toggle
charge_style.help: Hold: charge while you hold the power control. Toggle: press once to start charging, press again to stop. Toggle is for players who cannot hold a button down.

charge_style_p2.label: Charging stance: hold or toggle, player 2
charge_style_p2.help: The same for player two when two people play. Player one's is the one above.

transform_style.label: Transform: hold or toggle
transform_style.help: Hold: hold the transform controls for half a second. Toggle: press them once, together, and let go; the transform comes half a second later, and pressing either again before then cancels it. Toggle is for players who cannot hold buttons down.

transform_style_p2.label: Transform: hold or toggle, player 2
transform_style_p2.help: The same for player two when two people play. Player one's is the one above.

join_prompt.label: Player two join prompt
join_prompt.help: While one person plays the computer, a small note on the computer's side says player two can press any button to join. It fades after a while and stays in the pause menu.

show_recipe.label: Show recipe
show_recipe.help: A small readout of the mix of blows you have been throwing (light, heavy, energy), once the game reads your presses. Nothing is drawn yet.

beat_ring.label: Beat ring
beat_ring.help: A ring on the fighter about to be struck, closing on the moment the blow lands: on the rival for your blows, on you for his. For timing your presses, a parry or a counter. Off by default.

touch_preset.label: Touch layout
touch_preset.help: Simple: attack, guard and power buttons, and the game picks the rest. Full: a button for every action, best on a tablet.

left_handed.label: Left-handed touch layout
left_handed.help: On a touch screen, the buttons on the left and the move stick on the right.

unlock_all.label: Unlock all cosmetics
unlock_all.help: Every cosmetic can be equipped. Nothing is marked as earned: your real collection keeps counting and comes back when this is off.

thickness.label: Damage ring thickness
thickness.help: How thick the damage rings are: thin, normal or thick.

colour_vision.label: Color-blind mode
colour_vision.help: Swaps the colors that carry meaning (wear stages, stances, moods, and the two fighters' colors) for ones that stay apart with protanopia, deuteranopia or tritanopia. Off keeps the game's own colors. Everything also has a word, an icon or a shape.

text_size.label: Text size
text_size.help: How big the words are in the menus and on the screen. Large is a quarter bigger than Normal and Larger is half bigger. Where room is tight a line stays a little smaller, so it is never cut off.

you_marker.label: Mark my fighter
you_marker.help: A small marker over your fighter in your color. Always keeps it up through the fight, Intro shows it with the control hints at the start only, Off hides it.

hud_sides.label: Fighter panels
hud_sides.help: Fixed: player one's panel stays on the left, player two's on the right. Follow: the panels move over to the side their fighter is on, after the fighters have held their sides for a moment. They never move in the middle of an exchange, and with two players they stay in their own corners.

region_label.label: Place names
region_label.help: The place under the camera on the planet strip.

volume_master.label: Master volume
volume_master.help: How loud the whole game is, from 0% (silent) to 100%.

volume_effects.label: Effects volume
volume_effects.help: Blows, blasts, the world and the crowds, from 0% (silent) to 100%. Turn it down to hear the voices better.

volume_voice.label: Voice volume
volume_voice.help: The fighters' voices and grunts, from 0% (silent) to 100%.

mono_audio.label: Mono sound
mono_audio.help: Plays the same sound in both ears, for one earbud, one working ear or a single speaker. Sounds no longer tell you which side they come from.
